data.name: Petite Anse Hotel & Restaurant
data.description:
A 6-minute walk from the beaches of Sauteurs Bay, facing the Caribbean Sea, this relaxed hotel set in tropical gardens is 6 km from Levera National Park, 11 km from Belmont Estate offering plantation tours and a musuem, and 45 km from Maurice Bishop International Airport.
Featuring wood floors and rugs, airy rooms with sea views offer free Wi-Fi and safes, plus tea and coffeemakers. All come with terraces and en suite bathrooms. Beachfront bungalows feature verandas and minifridges.
Breakfast is included; other meals and drinks are available for a fee. There's also a restaurant offering farm-to-table dining, and a bar, plus an outdoor pool.
